posts.caption:
It is official: a Manifest spinoff is coming to Netflix. Titled 'Arrivals: A New Manifest Mystery', the series will explore uncharted storylines within the same world as the global phenomenon.

While the show introduces a new cast, the creative team remains familiar with Jeff Rake and former co-executive producers at the helm. Robert Zemeckis is also returning to executive produce the new mystery.
